Fills the missing values (holes) of a raster by interpolation of the valid cells around them.

**Toolbox folder:** Raster Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Null, Missing values, Holes, Interpolation, Raster<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.RasterMissingValuesFiller`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inRaster` | raster file |  |  | The raster in which to fill missing values. |
| `inMask` | raster file |  |  | An optional raster mask, on the grid of the input: only the holes on its valid cells are filled. |
| `inVectorMask` | vector file |  |  | An optional vector mask of polygons: only the holes inside them are filled. |
| `pMinDistance` | int |  | `0` | The cells at this distance or nearer are not used for the interpolation (in cells). |
| `pMaxDistance` | int |  | `10` | The max distance of the cells used for the interpolation (in cells). |
| `doUseOnlyBorderValues` | boolean |  | `false` | Use only the valid cells touching the holes, instead of all the valid cells within the max distance. |
| `pMode` | String |  | `IDW` | The interpolation mode. Allowed values: `IDW`, `LDW`, `TPS`, `AVERAGING`, `CATEGORIES`. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The filled raster. |
